note: Expected-red baseline for scripts/verify_production.py. verify_production has been continuously RED since 2026-08-01: each site fails the gates 'Pipeline resolved all placeholders' and 'No pytest.skip' because ASSERT targets cannot be resolved and the pipeline emits honest pytest.skip() lines. This is the known ASSERT-resolution class tracked as AI-058 / AI-064 / B-054 / B-055 — not a scraper or deps bug. Two variance tolerances, both derived from real runs, keep the verdict meaningful: (1) max_unresolved_placeholders is a CEILING, not the exact count — across 67 historical runs the per-site count of emitted pytest.skip lines ranged 0-4 (26x0, 19x1, 19x2, 1x3, 2x4), so the ceiling is 2x the observed max; (2) expected_failing_tests lists the ASSERT-heavy criteria that sometimes resolve-but-wrong instead of skipping (the same class) — a failure in any OTHER test is a regression. Use `python scripts/verify_production.py --baseline scripts/verify_production_baseline.json` for a regression verdict: only NEW gate failures, NEW failing tests, or an unresolved count above the ceiling fail. Re-record with `--save-baseline` after the resolver family closes the class.
